literal: Even fate, the back they will see, discouragement without, without delaying, those who strive.
translation: Those who strive unremittingly without discouragement will see even fate turn its back and retreat.
modern: மனச்சோர்வு இல்லாமல், காலம் தாழ்த்தாமல் முயற்சி செய்பவர்கள், விதியையும் புறமுதுகு காட்டி ஓடச் செய்வர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of relentless human effort over destiny. The poet asserts that even fate, which is often considered insurmountable, can be defeated and made to turn its back in retreat. This victory is achieved by those who labor without discouragement and without delaying or slacking. The key term 'உப்பக்கம்' literally means 'the back', symbolizing defeat, showing that persistent effort can overcome even the most adverse preordained circumstances.
